messages:
marie: FYI — VP at HelioSystems escalated this morning. Their CISO says they need a written attestation that Dedicated will not egress customer payloads, plus confirmation we support mTLS + customer KMS/HSM integration. They want answers by EOD tomorrow. Can eng + sec own?

devon: putting this on eng-runtime + eng-security. tagging @ruth and @ajay. do we have an attestation template we can reuse?

ruth: we have a baseline attestation for data residency + no-egress. I'll pull it and add the KMS/HSM section. Need specifics on network topology (private link vs peering) and whether the POC uses our hosted control plane.

ajay: quick notes from runtime side — Dedicated supports mTLS on the customer-facing endpoint, and we can deploy inside customer VPC via PrivateLink or VPC peering. For KMS: we can integrate with customer KMS via external key wrapping or let them manage CMKs in our onboarding flow.

marie: POC details: 7B fine-tuned model, seq len ~2048, target 100 qps sustained, 99th token latency target <200ms (they measure streaming time-to-first-token). POC will be in us-west. They want committed capacity for 8 GPUs.

leo: pricing note (ballpark for the exec): committed 8-GPU pool ~= $42k/mo + API unit usage for embeddings/gen. We can tighten if legal signs a 12mo commit. Will craft a concise number for the VP call.

maya: CS here — customer also asked for completed security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ-ish). Can someone own filling the infra/network bits and provide diagrams? I can take app-level controls.

carl: I'll be on the customer exec call tomorrow. Marie — please DM me the one-pager with the attestation + pricing paragraph. Need an ask for them (next steps) at the end.

ruth: action items for sec: I can prepare the attestation and a short Q&A doc. Need these from eng: network diagram (showing private link/peering), where keys live, rotation cadence, and audit log retention. If anyone has the template link, drop it here.

ajay: dropping a sample network snippet they can include in the diagram:

```
# Dedicated endpoint (example)
- client -> PrivateLink -> dedicated-inference-gateway (mTLS)
- KV cache + model shards on GPU pool (no outbound internet egress)
- control-plane calls to metrics (customer-only VPC peering)
```

ajay: for SLOs — 100 qps 7B is doable with 8 A100-equiv if batching tuned; to hit 99p <200ms we may need model quantization or smaller batch windows. Want to run a perf smoke tomorrow during the POC spin.

devon: eng action item list: (1) perf smoke with 7B model in staging (2) confirm mTLS config & sample config file (3) produce network diagram + KMS options. ETA: 18 hours.

marie: perfect. Ruth/Leo — can you both sign off on the attestation draft by noon tomorrow? I'll schedule the VP/Prod exec bridge for 3pm PT.

ruth: yes, will do.

leo: will review pricing paragraph and add fallback options (can propose burst capacity or lower GPU config).

ops-bot: deployment-notice: perf-smoke/staging scheduled for 2098766700 (in 15m) :rocket:

marie: quick ask — CISO wants an explicit line about "no customer data is shared outside of the customer's VPC or explicit integrations". Add that to the attestation please.

ruth: adding that sentence and creating a short appendix listing encryption and access controls. Sharing first draft link in 45m.

carl: thanks all. if eng can confirm the perf numbers tomorrow morning I'll take the VP call with a firm SLA/price.

marie: noted. I'll keep this thread updated with docs + links. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
